title: The Weighted Crescent Method
summary: A method that lets the guandao's own weight and a pulse of qi do the cutting for students who already know the basics.

title: Qi Along the Long Curved Blade
summary: A short text on holding a steady stream of qi along the blade's whole curve to sharpen every cut.

title: Sweeps and Hooks of the Pole Blade
summary: A text on wide sweeps and the curved blade's hooking pull to unbalance and cut down standing opponents.

title: A Canon of Guard and Cleave
summary: A canon that teaches holding the pole as a guard and turning that guard into a cleaving cut with qi.

title: Practice of the Turning Crescent
summary: A practice book of pivots and turning cuts that carry the crescent blade around the body with qi.

title: The Long Reach Discipline
summary: A discipline of fighting at the far end of the pole to keep opponents beyond the reach of their own arms.

title: Treatise on Pole-Blade Pressure
summary: A treatise on bearing down with the blade's weight and the pole's length to force an opponent back and open.

title: Hooking Edge and Haft Lessons
summary: Lessons that use the curved blade's hook and the pole's shaft together to trap and wrench away enemy weapons.

title: The Qi-Carried Guandao Drill
summary: A drill series that teaches the guandao student to carry qi through a full cut and back into the guard.
